SELECT json_object("config",(SELECT json_group_array(json_object("service",service,"value",json(value))) FROM service_config),"bookings",(SELECT json_group_array(json_object("id",booking_id,"req",request_id,"flight",flight_id,"pax",passenger_id,"amount",amount_cents,"status",status,"ref",client_reference)) FROM bookings),"charges",(SELECT json_group_array(json_object("id",charge_id,"booking",booking_id,"key",idempotency_key,"amount",amount_cents,"state",state,"step",created_step)) FROM charges),"events",(SELECT json_group_array(json_object("request",request_id,"kind",kind,"step",step)) FROM customer_events),"outbox",(SELECT json_group_array(json_object("id",event_id,"booking",booking_id,"payload",payload,"status",status)) FROM outbox),"fares",(SELECT json_group_array(json_object("flight",flight_id,"price",price_cents,"version",version,"capacity",capacity)) FROM flights),"cache",(SELECT json_group_array(json_object("key",key,"value",value)) FROM cache),"fare_holds",(SELECT json_group_array(json_object("flight",flight_id,"price",price_cents,"until",until_step)) FROM fare_holds)) AS state

SELECT b.booking_id,b.request_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents,b.client_reference,c.charge_id,c.idempotency_key,c.state,c.created_step,e.kind,e.step AS cancel_step FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id LEFT JOIN customer_events e ON e.request_id=b.request_id WHERE b.status='pending' ORDER BY c.created_step,b.booking_id
